entry.title: WIRELESS GAMING HEADPHONES IN NOCTURNE & LAKE BLUE
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Smart Home & Tech
Price: 650.00

Transform your gaming experience with the Datum Dahleez Wireless Gaming Headphones. Immerse yourself in crystal-clear audio and hear every detail with custom Beryllium drivers and exceptional acoustics with independent volume controls for mic and game so you won't miss a move. The detachable boom microphone and internal mic array provide exceptional talk quality even when the boom mic is detached, allowing for optimal communication in a sophisticated, flexible design.

Crafted from premium materials, the lightweight magnesium ear cups paired with cushioned lambskin leather pads, an Alcantara®-lined inner headband for enhanced grip, and a coated canvas outer headband offer unparalleled comfort during play and a wear that only gets better with time. Plus, for longer playtime, on-head detection preserves the battery life of your wireless gaming headphones.

Stay online for longer and get to 50% battery life in only 30 minutes of charging. Use the low-latency adapter to eliminate audio delays and effortlessly switch between your PC and console with convenient plug and play. An optional USB-C to 3.5mm analog connection for other compatible consoles provides added versatility.

entry.title: WIRELESS ACTIVE NOISE CANCELLING HEADPHONES IN NOCTURNE & LAKE BLUE
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Smart Home & Tech
Price: 750.00

The Datum Dahleez Wireless Headphones offer a blend of functionality and style, in a lightweight anodized aluminium, durable tempered glass, and soft lambskin leather promote longer wear in a sleek, luxurious finish. Boasting replaceable memory foam ear pads and a felted hard shell travel case to provide additional comfort and protection on-the-go. With angled ear cups fine-tuned for an even wider soundstage, the custom 40mm Beryllium coated drivers evenly distribute our expansive, signature sound in the form of warmer lows and richer highs.

Adaptive Active Noise Cancelling automatically adjusts the level of noise cancellation to match your surroundings, leaving behind nothing but the sound you want. Enjoy up to 32 hours of total battery life or up to 28 hours with Active Noise Cancellation enabled. For optimal battery usage, proximity sensors allow for on-head detection to auto-pause your Datum Dahleez Wireless Headphones, so you get the most out of your listening time.
